polyethylene.interpretation: Eionet EU-2018 finished-output assumptions define HDPE and Bio-HDPE processing shares across 12 world regions and years. Principal resin and native forming-service quantities remain separate.

pet.interpretation: Eionet EU-2018 finished-output assumptions define PET and Bio-PET processing shares. Blow molding and injection are alternative allocated operations.

pp.interpretation: Eionet EU-2018 finished-output assumptions define PP processing shares across 12 world regions and years. Native operations supply yields and inventory quantities.

pvc.interpretation: Eionet EU-2018 finished-output assumptions define PVC processing shares: 51% pipe extrusion, 18% rigid-sheet calendering, 29% injection and 2% blow molding. Calendering supplies sheet forming. The native recipe determines finished yield, principal input and PVC-waste treatment.

ps_forming.interpretation: Normalized LBNL 2019 finished-output pools assign (7.4+2.1) Mt foam to foaming, (2.7+7.2) Mt solid GPPS/HIPS to injection and 1.2 Mt residual PS to film extrusion. Native operation yields, auxiliaries and waste remain separate from principal resin supply.

tyre.interpretation: Fixed finished-output operation shares transferred across 12 world regions and years. Original rounded weights are retained here and normalized once by the composition owner. Operation sources separately define inventory quantities and principal-resin requirements.
